about: Where the game's stat icons sit on texticons.png, the sheet item tooltips draw them from. The game publishes no map of the sheet, so these were found by hand: by matching each against the League wiki's named stat icons (Attack speed icon.png and so on), which are cut from the game. `pixels` is a hash of what the 20x20 tile draws (its RGBA pixels, fully transparent ones cleared): `npm run data:art` stops when one no longer matches, and `npm run data:art -- --accept` records the tiles as they are now once they have been looked at.
